label: web app request lifecycle v1
note: 4 zones (Client, Edge, Backend, Data), 9 numbered steps, sync vs async arrows, legend.
author: claude-opus-5-5

elements.text:
1  User types a URL or clicks a link
2  DNS turns the domain into an IP address
3  Browser opens HTTPS to the CDN; static files (JS, CSS, images) come straight back from the edge
4  Dynamic API calls pass through to the load balancer
5  Load balancer picks a healthy app server
6  App checks the cache first (fast path)
7  On a miss it queries the database, then fills the cache
8  Slow work (emails, image resize) goes onto a queue so the user isn't kept waiting
9  A background worker picks it up async

Solid = sync request/response (response retraces the path back to the browser, which renders it)
Dashed = async, fire-and-forget
